notes: IFC4X3_ADD2 and IFC4 versions of the same scene were compared entity by entity via GlobalId. GlobalIds are stable across the two versions, entity #ids are not.

IFC 4.0 has no infrastructure spatial types: IFCBRIDGE/IFCROAD/IFCRAILWAY map to IFCBUILDING and IFCBRIDGEPART/IFCROADPART/IFCRAILWAYPART map to IFCBUILDINGSTOREY (Infra-Road keeps a two-level IFCBUILDING nest for the two IFCROADPART levels, so the spatial node count is identical: 31 in both).

Infra-Bridge is the one place where the mapping is not 1:1. The 7 '... - pier' nodes are IFCBRIDGEPART (spatial) in IFC4X3 but IFCELEMENTASSEMBLY (physical element) in IFC4, keeping the same GlobalIds. That is why Infra-Bridge has 28 spatials / 50 elements in ifc4x3 but 21 spatials / 57 elements in ifc4.
Infra-Landscaping exists only in the IFC4 directory; there is no IFC4X3 counterpart to compare against.
Content mismatch between the two versions of Infra-Road: ifc4/Infra-Road.ifc carries 26 Qto_SlabBaseQuantities sets (78 quantities), while ifc4x3/Infra-Road.ifc contains no IFCELEMENTQUANTITY at all.

Road markings: in IFC4X3 the 20 IFCSURFACEFEATUREs of Infra-Road hang off their host slabs through 4 IFCRELADHERESTOELEMENT relations and inherit the host's space (container_via='adheres'); in IFC4 the same 20 features are listed directly in IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE (container_via='direct').
'sand bedding' is IFCEARTHWORKSFILL in IFC4X3 and IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY in IFC4 (Building-Architecture), same GlobalId 3_4VN63S96DfWiJjgG8j1C.

Units are mixed by quantity kind and are consistent in every file: LENGTHUNIT = IFCSIUNIT(.MILLI.,.METRE.), AREAUNIT = .SQUARE_METRE., VOLUMEUNIT = .CUBIC_METRE.. No IfcQuantity overrides the unit locally (attribute 3 'Unit' is $ everywhere), so the project assignment applies. Cross-checked: NetVolume == NetArea * Depth/1000 holds for all 38 elements that carry all three, confirming the mm/m2/m3 mix.

The answer_format example in task.json states task 'T001' and a global_id of '1Ln2$YEIz2xxvw2$Q8dGpV' for the '00 groundfloor' storey; the task id is T002 and that storey's real GlobalId is '1Ano2ZUxnEIvVQ_beukl8b' (#40 in ifc4x3, #43 in ifc4). The rest of the example (parent 30, depth 4, NetArea 25.749999999991743, SQUARE_METRE) reproduces exactly. 'T002' and the real GlobalId are used here.
